text:
sana: Quick nav IA proposal — reorganize left nav, add breadcrumbs and deep-linking behavior. TL;DR: group by workflow (Project > Model > Deployment > Monitor), add breadcrumbs, support deep links to tabs.

alex: :eyes: Can we keep legacy routes for bookmarks? Need 301 fallback + telemetry.

liz: Accessibility nits: use aria-current on active breadcrumb, ensure keyboard focus rings on sidebar items, ensure 'skip to content' works. Contrast on active state seems low.

matt: Routing Q — server redirect vs client-side hydrate? If client only, hitting /projects/:pid/models/:mid requires SSR hydration or a fetch-on-mount spinner. I suggest server redirect to project page when projectId missing.

ryan: From PM: analytics for deep-link usage + migration plan for bookmarks. Non-admins should not see project-level nav entries. Also, copy consistency: 'Model Registry' vs 'Models'?

sana: Example URL patterns:
```
/projects/:projectId
/projects/:projectId/models
/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId
/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId/evals
/projects/:projectId/deployments/:deploymentId
```
Nav config sketch:
```
[
  { "id": "projects", "label": "Projects", "children": [...] }
]
```

alex: Add ?ref=integrations param for external deep-links so we can route from partner apps.

nav-ci-bot: Deployed experimental branch 'nav-ia-v2' to staging. :rocket:

liz: UX asks: collapse breadcrumbs on mobile, reduce sidebar header height, and copy tweak suggestion: 'Models' -> 'Model Registry'. Also reorder to group Monitoring under Deployments.

matt: Proposed experiment: A/B test control vs regrouped sidebar. Measure mean path length to open model details and incidence of 404 for deep links.

sana: I'll upload hi-fi mocks + accessibility checklist. Can design review by Fri? @liz @alex

liz: Will review. Sending checklist now.

alex: I'll open a routing PR with redirects + integration tests for bookmarked links.

nav-ci-bot: Reminder: canary rollout scheduled in 48h unless blocked. :alarm_clock:

sana: Thanks all — will sync next week in design review slot. :v:
